class.name: ECSEntityProxy
class.brief_description: High-level Variant wrapper for a raw ECS Entity.
class.description: [ECSEntityProxy] allows GDScript to interact with ECS entities through Godot's standard property system. It provides a bridge between low-level DOD (Data Oriented Design) and high-level scripting.

method.name: set_entity
method.description: Binds this proxy to a specific 64-bit entity ID.

method.name: get_entity
method.description: Returns the current entity ID this proxy represents.

method.name: sync_telemetry
method.description: Updates the proxy's internal state with real-time simulation data from the entity.
